source: Derived 20 October 2026 from the escrow clause list (skeletons/escrow.json): what genuinely varies between the firm's escrow precedents.
name: Escrow agreement drafting decisions
applyWhere: the clause named above, the definitions in Article 1, the parties and recitals, Schedule A (Notices), Schedule B (Accounts) and any other clause that depends on it
closing: That completes the drafting decisions. What remains are the deal's facts — the parties and their offices, the Signing Date, the accounts and their banks, the Concession Agreement's date, the notice details and the fee of the Escrow Agent. Give them to me in the chat, or point me at the project documents that hold them, and I will fill each [●].

questions.title: Arbitration forum
questions.question: Where will disputes under this agreement be finally resolved?
questions.location: Article 8 (Governing Law & Dispute Resolution), the Arbitration section
questions.basis: Owner's decision of 20 October 2026: arbitration has no default and is always asked; the firm's precedents use both the Arbitration Act, 1940 and SIAC.

options.label: Arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940, seated in Pakistan
options.hint: The firm's usual forum for a domestic counterparty

options.label: Arbitration under the SIAC Rules, seated in Singapore
options.hint: Where a foreign party or lender asks for an offshore seat

options.label: Another forum
options.hint: State it: another institution or seat, or the courts

questions.title: Government funding accounts
questions.question: Does the Government fund an account under the escrow (a minimum revenue guarantee or a similar contribution)?
questions.location: Article 3 (MRG Funding Account, MRG Funding Amount, MRG Contribution Amount, Encashment Proceeds & Related Matters); the related definitions; Schedule B (Accounts)
questions.basis: The firm's escrow precedents differ: one carries the Government's minimum revenue guarantee accounts, another the Government's funding and viability gap accounts, another none.

options.label: Yes — keep the Government's funding accounts article
options.hint: Fill the account names and the funding mechanics

options.label: No — the Government funds no account
options.hint: Remove the article, or mark it "Not Used", with its definitions and Schedule B rows

questions.title: Step-in and substitution
questions.question: Do the Financiers need the escrow to follow their step-in and substitution rights under the Concession Direct Agreement?
questions.location: Article 7 ("Not Used" in the pack; Step-In, Substitution & Concession Direct Agreement Coordination where it applies)
questions.basis: The firm's 2026 escrow agreement has the article; the pack's base marks Article 7 "Not Used".

options.label: Yes — write Article 7 as the step-in coordination article
options.hint: Acknowledgement of the Concession Direct Agreement, coordination with step-in, substitution, termination payments, the Finance Parties' rights

questions.title: Agent Bank
questions.question: Is there an Agent Bank party acting for the Financiers?
questions.location: The parties, the recitals, Schedule A (Notices) and the signature pages
questions.basis: The pack's base has four parties (the Government, the Concessionaire, the Escrow Agent and the Agent Bank); an unfinanced project has no Agent Bank.

options.label: Yes — four parties, with the Agent Bank
No — remove the Agent Bank as a party
options.hint: Its notice block, signature page and references go
